The per-experiment half of the adapter contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file. Narrative is carried over from the legacy run_pvt_sweep.sh record text; it is not a new claim.
Infrastructure/plumbing evidence for issue #65's port, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row (spec/ tracks no ratified SG13CMOS5L accuracy target).
Claim: sg13g2-bandgap's SG13CMOS5L bandgap_core (design/sg13cmos5l/bandgap_core.sch, issue #64) produces a PTAT delta-VEB across its real pnpMPA legs (Q1 unit vs Q2 8x-area, both grounded-collector/diode-connected) and a summed CTAT+PTAT vref, across the full temperature x supply x MOS/resistor-process-corner x pnpMPA-process-corner grid, when its real sg13_hv_pmos mirror is biased open-loop from a diode-connected replica leg (isolating the core's own PTAT/CTAT generation from the real amplifier's loop dynamics; sg13cmos5l-closed-loop-startup is the companion with the loop closed). Infrastructure/plumbing evidence, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row.
Devices: All real PDK compact models -- pnpMPA (Gummel-Poon), sg13_hv_pmos (PSP103.6 via psp103.osdi), rppd (r3_cmc via r3_cmc.osdi). No ideal-primitive substitutions.
Netlist provenance: design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/bandgap_core.spice, device-for-device, plus the open-loop bias and ammeter fixtures documented in testbench/ and README.md (schematic-sourced; the body template is hand-maintained from the legacy template, so D2-style freshness is a schematic-signature check only).
PDK: `ihp-sg13cmos5l` -- the TARGET/SETUP pin in sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json (IHP-Open-PDK dev subtree, sibling `ihp-sg13g2/` required). No record has yet been generated on that pin, so runtime compatibility is UNVERIFIED until the first one exists; a record minted from this spec must be read against the pin its run actually resolved (report `environment`), not against this sentence. OSDI models: sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json "osdi_toolchain".
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points) with pnpMPA (cornerPNP.lib) x MOS-hv (cornerMOShv.lib) x resistor (cornerRES.lib) sections paired per sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py CORNER_SECTIONS
